Jade NPC
by Malic for Stardew Valley[/b]

Jade is an entomologist, lover of all things magical, and generally an odd person to meet.
Fully romanceable and marryable. Can you figure out this odd girls secrets?

Jade's birthday is on Winter 4th. She will appear at festivals and has her own spouse room.

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]ContentPatcher
[/list]

[b][size=4]Gifts[/size][/b]
[spoiler] ﻿[b]LOVES [/b]Elvish Jewelry, Fairy Seeds, Fairy Stone, Fairy Rose, Jade.
﻿[b]LIKES [/b]Gems, Minerals, Flowers, Monster Loot, Foraging. Snail, Hashbrowns, Pancakes, Chocolate Cake, Pink Cake, Cookie, Ice Cream, Blueberry Tart
﻿[b]NEUTRAL TO [/b]Food, Syrups, Cooking ingredients, Artisan Goods.
﻿[b]DISLIKES [/b]Eggs, Milks, Bait, Fishing Tackles.
﻿[b]HATES [/b]Meats, Fish, Fertilizer, Junk.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Heart Events[/b][/size]
[spoiler] - [b]2[/b] - Visit the Forest south of your farm between 8am and 8pm on a sunny day
﻿- [b]4[/b] - Visit the Forest south of your farm between 4pm and 8pm on a sunny day.
﻿- [b]6[/b] - Visit the Forest south of your farm between 11am and 2pm on a sunny day.
﻿- [b]8[/b] - Visit the Forest south of your farm between 8pm and 9pm on a sunny day that's not in winter.
﻿- [b]8.2[/b] - After getting mail, visit the railroads between 4pm-5pm on a sunny day. Must have seen heart event 8. You cannot be dating Jade and must have selected the platonic option in the 8th heart event.
﻿- [b]10[/b] - After getting mail, visit the railroads between 4pm-5pm on a sunny day. Must have seen heart event 8. You must be dating Jade or have selected the romantic option in the 8th heart event.[/spoiler]
